author: Marlon Chaviano
name: saas-nuxt
title: SaaS with Nuxt UI
description: Nuxt UI's official SaaS template: landing, pricing, blog, docs and account pages already designed, with Nuxt Content and dark mode.

base.command: npx -y tiged nuxt-ui-templates/saas {{name}} && cd {{name}} && npm pkg delete packageManager

instructions:
## How to work here

- The content (landing, pricing, blog, docs) is in `content/` and Nuxt Content renders it.
- Use Nuxt UI components before building your own; the theme goes in `app/app.config.ts`.
- Anything that needs a session or secrets goes in `server/api/`, never on the client.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`.
